title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for post-heart transplant status.

Denies any symptoms of rejection or other transplant complications. Tolerating tacrolimus well without significant side effects. No complaints of fatigue, dyspnea, or chest pain.

Medication List
- Tacrolimus 1mg BID
- Lisinopril 10mg QD
- Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
CV: RRR, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Resp: CTAB, no wheezes or rales.
Skin: Intact, no rashes.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Status post heart transplant. Doing well on tacrolimus. No evidence of rejection.

Plan
- Continue current tacrolimus dose.
- Routine labs to monitor tacrolimus levels.
- F/u in 3 months.
